_doc: Worry state and drift (docs/AGENT_FRAMEWORK.md section 3, campussim/worry.py). mode 'off' (default) keeps run ids and output unchanged; 'on' gives every agent a worry level in [0, 1]. baseline = neuroticism_baseline[0] + (neuroticism_baseline[1] - neuroticism_baseline[0]) * neuroticism with Big Five on, else baseline_archetype[archetype] (the same map applied to personality.json's archetype mean neuroticism). Worry relaxes toward the baseline with half_life_days (sim time) and jumps on events: level += jumps[kind] * (1 - level). Effects scale with (level - baseline), so nothing changes at baseline: compliance and mask propensity shift by effects.* on the logit scale (mask: the per-agent propensity before the activity context factor); P(drop a planned optional activity in drop_acts, i.e. stay home in drop_to_act instead) = clip(effects.drop_optional * (level - baseline), 0, drop_p_max), decided once per planned block. worry.csv.gz logs every jump / measured value, all baselines at t=0, and hourly rows for agents whose level moved more than log_min_change since their last row. Jumps and weights are placeholders until the calibration loop fits them from Claude agents' worry answers.
